company.name: Bantam Bagels
company.one_liner: Mini bagel balls stuffed with cream cheese, from a New York bagel shop.

facts.summary: A husband-and-wife team runs a small New York shop selling bite-sized bagel balls with the cream cheese already inside.
highlights: Sales are about $200,000 so far, mostly from one shop and delivery.
The product is unique and easy to eat on the go.
They want to get into grocery freezers and coffee shops.
Food manufacturing at scale is expensive and tricky.

outcome.headline: Landed in Starbucks nationwide and sold for $34 million in 2018.
outcome.story: Lori got Bantam Bagels into Starbucks and thousands of grocery stores. In 2018 the company was sold to T. Marzetti for $34 million, a huge win for early investors.
